gloss: bento shop; bento restaurant; takeout lunch shop

definitions.explanation: A shop that makes and sells boxed lunches ({弁当|べんとう}) for takeout. Common near train stations, offices, and busy streets in Japan.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}の{弁当屋|べんとうや}で{昼食|ちゅうしょく}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought lunch at the bento shop in front of the station.

examples.japanese: この{弁当屋|べんとうや}は{安|やす}くておいしい。
examples.english: This bento shop is cheap and tasty.

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しい{日|ひ}は{近所|きんじょ}の{弁当屋|べんとうや}でご{飯|はん}を{済|す}ませる。
examples.english: On busy days I get a meal from the neighborhood bento shop.

notes:
Compound of {弁当|べんとう} (boxed lunch) + the suffix {屋|や} (shop). The suffix {屋|や} attaches to many goods to name the shop or seller: {本屋|ほんや} (bookstore), {花屋|はなや} (florist), {肉屋|にくや} (butcher).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弁当屋|べんとうや}で{買|か}う: to buy at a bento shop
- {駅前|えきまえ}の{弁当屋|べんとうや}: the bento shop in front of the station
- {手作|てづく}りの{弁当屋|べんとうや}: a handmade-bento shop
